Team —

We have one sprint left before the board packet freeze. Please treat the next 48 hours as a last-mile hygiene window for any deals that are being presented as committed in the Q3 corridor. Action items: 

- Update stages in HubSpot to the exact legal/contracting state (Contract Sent / PO Received / Verbal Commit). No fuzzy "commit" tags.
- Populate the commit date and expected invoice month in the commit_tracker_RWI-2026-345.csv (attached).
- Drop a one-line evidence note (Doc link, PO file name, or legal contact) in the Comments column.
- Flag anything that should be moved to "upside" if we don't have hard evidence by EOD Monday (our board freeze).

Attached: commit_tracker_RWI-2026-345.csv (single-line summary for each deal). I will compile the evidence pack and share a drive link once the updates are in.

Deadline: EOD Monday, Aug 2 UTC. If you have external dependencies (legal/procurement signoff), call them out here and tag the owner.
